## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and linked issue.

## Validation

- [ ] `dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed ...`
- [ ] `flutter analyze`
- [ ] Relevant `flutter test` commands
- [ ] Documentation updated where needed

## Checklist

- [ ] The public API does not expose internal or plugin-specific types.
- [ ] The change is focused and includes meaningful tests.
- [ ] No private images, credentials, generated build outputs, or temporary files are included.
